manifests.package.json:
{
  "name": "wled-mqtt-bridge",
  "version": "4.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "WLED MQTT Bridge connects device APIs to MQTT.",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.28.9",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=26.13.0 <27"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "ncc build src/main.ts -o dist --source-map --minify",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "tsx watch src/main.ts",
    "lint": "eslint . --max-warnings=0",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --config jest.config.ts --runInBand",
    "docs:dev": "pnpm --dir docs dev",
    "docs:build": "pnpm --dir docs build",
    "changeset": "changeset"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@nestjs/common": "^12.3.2",
    "@nestjs/core": "^12.3.2",
    "@nestjs/platform-express": "^12.3.2",
    "axios": "^1.21.0",
    "dotenv": "^18.0.9",
    "envalid": "^9.0.0",
    "js-yaml": "^5.5.0",
    "mqtt": "^5.16.1",
    "reflect-metadata": "^0.2.2",
    "rxjs": "^7.8.2",
    "ws": "^8.22.1",
    "zod": "^4.6.7"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@changesets/changelog-github": "^1.0.1",
    "@changesets/cli": "^3.0.3",
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",
    "@nestjs/testing": "^12.3.2",
    "@types/jest": "^30.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^26.6.6",
    "@types/ws": "^8.18.2",
    "@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin": "^8.72.1",
    "@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.72.1",
    "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@^7.0.2",
    "@vercel/ncc": "^0.45.0",
    "eslint": "^10.14.0",
    "eslint-config-prettier": "^10.1.8",
    "eslint-plugin-prettier": "^5.5.7",
    "jest": "^30.5.2",
    "prettier": "^3.9.10",
    "prettier-plugin-organize-imports": "^4.3.0",
    "ts-jest": "^29.4.15",
    "tsx": "^4.23.15",
    "typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.72.1"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/open-mqtt-bridges/wled.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://open-mqtt-bridges.github.io/wled/",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/open-mqtt-bridges/wled/issues"
  }
}
